$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the care pack composed with a concierge internal-medicine content seed, re-registered in the parlor register (a Southern parlor in daylight: magnolia blush, walnut ink, gilt hairlines) with its own pinned page skeletons. Everything else — pages' builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Concierge Medicine Practice
description: A concierge primary-care site with real online booking: Magnolia Concierge Medicine, two internists and a nurse care coordinator in a brick house in Green Hills, Nashville — membership from $250 a month, limited to 400 members. It opens full-bleed on a doctor and a patient laughing at a walnut table under magnolia windows ("Time with your doctor. Imagine that."), then three promises (same-day access, sixty-minute visits, your doctor's cell), the first year as a photographic timeline (the two-hour physical, labs reviewed together, specialists coordinated, a house call, the year in review), the membership price list, how it works alongside insurance, the physicians with portraits, members' words shared with consent, a plain FAQ, and a booking page offering a free introduction call, visits, and the annual physical. The booking form is clinically empty — name, contact, visit type, new/returning.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so these practice and appointments seeds replace the base pack's at compose and mirror THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twins) — the composed template's Manage editors and booking widget open on the concierge practice, not the base clinic.

providers.name: Dr. Nadia Beaumont
providers.bio: Nadia practiced hospital medicine at a large Nashville system for twelve years, seeing thirty patients a day, before opening Magnolia with a promise to see eight. She is board-certified in internal medicine, still makes most of the house calls herself, and will tell you exactly what your cholesterol number means over a cup of coffee.

providers.name: Dr. Theo Marchetti
providers.bio: Theo trained in internal medicine and spent five years in a rural clinic outside Knoxville, where knowing a patient's whole story wasn't optional. He looks after members with diabetes, heart and thyroid conditions, and anyone who has been told to 'watch it' without being told how.

providers.name: Marisol Dela Cruz
providers.bio: Marisol is the reason your specialist appointment happens next week instead of next quarter. She books referrals, chases records, reads every note that comes back, and answers the practice line — usually by the second ring.

services.name: The two-hour physical
services.description: Every year, a comprehensive visit with your physician: history, exam, screenings, and a written plan you take home.

services.name: Same-day and next-day visits
services.description: Sick on a Tuesday morning? Call or text, and you'll be seen that day, in the office, by video, or at home.

services.name: House calls
services.description: For a fever, a fall, a post-surgery check, or a parent who can't easily get out. Green Hills, Belle Meade, and nearby.

services.name: Labs, reviewed together
services.description: Blood drawn in the office, results explained at the table — what's normal, what's changed, and what we do about it.

services.name: Specialist coordination
services.description: We choose the specialist, send your history, book the appointment, and read the notes when they come back.

services.name: Ongoing and preventive care
services.description: Blood pressure, diabetes, thyroid, cholesterol, sleep, travel medicine, and the screenings your age calls for.

insurance: Labs and imaging billed to your plan

reviews.quote: My first physical took two hours and nobody looked at a clock. Dr. Beaumont found the thing three other doctors had missed, and then she called me that Saturday to see how I was doing.
reviews.name: Caroline W.

reviews.quote: I texted Dr. Marchetti at seven in the morning with a fever. He was at my kitchen table by nine. I didn't know medicine could still work like this.
reviews.name: Devon R.

reviews.quote: Marisol got my mother in with a cardiologist in six days and then sat with me to go over the notes. That alone is worth the membership.
reviews.name: Priya S.

newPatient.title: A twenty-minute introduction
newPatient.body: A call with one of our physicians to talk about your health, what you're looking for, and whether membership is the right fit. There's no charge and no obligation.

newPatient.title: Enrollment
newPatient.body: Choose monthly or annual membership and sign a one-page agreement. We request your records from your previous doctor, so you don't have to.

newPatient.title: Your two-hour physical
newPatient.body: Within your first two weeks. Come hungry for the fasting labs, and bring a list of every question you've been saving up.

newPatient.title: Your physician's number
newPatient.body: At the end of your first visit you'll have your doctor's cell number. Use it.

types.name: Introduction call
types.description: A free call to see whether membership is the right fit.

types.name: Two-hour physical
types.description: Your annual comprehensive visit, for members.

types.name: Visit
types.description: An hour with your physician, in the office or by video.

theme.$comment: The parlor register in its own walnut: mode light opens the site in its native appearance (magnolia blush by day); dark is the same parlor by lamplight. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-inks pages and app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared careShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop): the concierge practice takes the centered masthead — the name set like an engraved card over its links.

landing.$comment: A pinned layout (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): style re-registers the base's pages in the parlor register, and pages carries exactly the skeletons careLanding.ts emits from this remix's contentSeed — the hero turns full-bleed and the content-gated sections (promises, journey, menu, faq) appear because the seed asks for them — so the composed template's document reproduces its code config section for section (tests/View/Care/careLanding.test.ts reads this through composedLandingSeed).
